doc.title: Bobby Johnson Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998

title: Closing and plans to play
summary: He says he still plays; Monk Rowe thanks him and they go to set up.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I understand we’re going to do a little playing, filming a show at some point.
So I want to thank you very much for your time, and we’re going to go get set up in the next room.
Oh, great. And thank you. Thank you very much.
So we’re going to play some later maybe. Thank you.
